components.css: .ds-button-primary { font-family:"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans KR","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif; display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 20px;min-height:46px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:11px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;background:var(--primary,#2b6f60);color:white;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s; } .ds-button-primary:hover {background:#235d50;} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2b6f60); outline-offset:3px; }.ds-button-primary:disabled {opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-button-primary {transition:none;}}

components.name: Evaluation detail controls
components.description: Three compact workbench toggles expose evidence, guidance history, or learning activity beneath the selected criterion context; selected state is underlined.
components.css: .ds-review-tabs{font-family:"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans KR","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif;display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid #cbd5cf;padding-top:8px;margin-bottom:16px}.ds-review-tabs button{font:inherit;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;background:transparent;padding:12px 10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-muted,#606d64);min-height:48px;cursor:pointer}.ds-review-tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--primary,#2b6f60);color:var(--primary,#2b6f60);font-weight:700}.ds-review-tabs button:hover{background:var(--surface-context,#eef6f2)}.ds-review-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2b6f60);outline-offset:3px}.ds-review-tabs button>span{background:var(--background,#f2f3ee);border-radius:6px;padding:0 6px;font-size:12px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-review-tabs{gap:0}.ds-review-tabs button{padding:10px 6px;flex:1;font-size:13px;gap:5px;justify-content:center}.ds-review-tabs button>span{display:none}} .ds-review-tabs svg{flex-shrink:0}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-review-tabs svg{width:16px}}

narrative.overview:
TRACE carries the supplied dashboard and sidebar references into a Korean teaching workspace: a deep green navigation rail, warm gray page, white rounded panels, and pale mint selected destinations. Larger headings, readable controls, and section icons establish a clear working hierarchy without decorative imagery.

The shared presentation in src/workspace.css builds on src/index.css and src/app.css. Network practice and fusion projects share the same visual system and role-specific screen structure; their scenario data does not introduce separate navigation or card families. Surface-specific composition remains in the design brief.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green navigation with a pale mint active destination and green text.
Warm gray canvas, flat white working panels, and semantic context, interpretation, and attention surfaces.
Clear Korean type hierarchy, labeled section icons, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: Use deep green for primary actions and pale mint with green text for the active sidebar destination. Criterion and evidence selection retain white surfaces with green outlines or borders; detail tabs use a green underline. Filled option controls retain their established local states.

rules.name: The Surface Meaning Rule
rules.body: Keep task context, neutral teacher input, AI interpretation, attention, and raw execution output visually distinct; do not use their fills as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Category Color Rule
rules.body: Evaluation and observation bars use the shared mint, lavender, yellow, rose, and charcoal sequence to distinguish categories. Keep project colors stable when filters change, preserve labels and values beside color, and retain each chart’s numeric scale. Color does not turn support usage or evidence coverage into an ability score.

rules.name: The Reading Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep page and section titles visibly above body content; reserve the smallest text for counts, provenance, timestamps, and supporting notes.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Put the current task and judgment controls before supporting detail, and keep final actions in document flow rather than a sticky footer.

rules.name: The Overlay Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary panels flat; reserve shadows for dialogs and transient notifications.

dos: Do preserve the supplied green and mint identity and the shared structure across both scenarios.
Do distinguish raw evidence, AI interpretation, and teacher judgment with labeled semantic surfaces.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do retain diverse category colors, text labels, and numeric meaning in evaluation and observation charts.
Do expose count definitions, missing evidence, and source links beside observation percentages.
donts: Don't restore the superseded charcoal active navigation treatment.
Don't use semantic surfaces as interchangeable decoration or add ambient panel shadows.
Don't reduce body content to supporting-note sizes to fit a crowded panel.
Don't restore prior-course knowledge-connection cards or course-origin labels in guidance.
